_rationale.minRecall: A false negative means an agent keeps a belief that the code no longer supports, so recall is gated far more tightly than precision. It is deliberately not 1.0 because the corpus contains a small number of mutations whose labels are debatable; see the FN analysis in the eval report.
_rationale.minKnowledgeRetentionRate: Share of semantic-preserving edits that do NOT discard knowledge. This is the metric a file-hash baseline scores 0.0 on and is the practical reason the system exists.
_rationale.mustBeatArm: B2_file_hash is what most tooling does today. If we cannot beat it by a wide margin the contribution claim fails.
